extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and potential article creators / contributors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for people who encounter a missing Wikipedia page and want to create or locate the article—covers account requirements, searching for existing pages/links, title capitalization, redirects, creation delays, and checking deletion logs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Comedy 2026 political' in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for pages within Wikipedia that might use different capitalization, phrasing, or redirects; use the search box to find variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status required to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot create the page directly, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are alternative workflows for contributors who are not able or ready to publish a new article immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for existing pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding backlinks can reveal whether the topic is covered under another title or whether a redirect should be created.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may not be immediately visible
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to see the page; creation visibility can be delayed by the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and add redirects when appropriate so readers can find the article under common spellings.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page has been deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons and logs to understand why a prior article was removed before attempting to recreate it.
